checks.name: identity
checks.reason: The rounded workshop robot retains its large head, rounded torso, two arms, two feet and matching panel details across supplied views.

checks.name: appearance
checks.reason: Blue and cream hard surfaces with copper joints and trim match the request. No props or hair are present or required.

checks.name: framing
checks.reason: The entire robot, including hands and feet, remains inside every sampled frame. Feet retain their sampled positions.

checks.name: deformation
checks.reason: During the raised-arm poses, the moving wrist and hand develop long, thin trailing spikes instead of preserving the compact hard-surface shape visible at rest.

limitations: Supplied structural proofs report successful loading and numerical movement; they do not establish action meaning or acceptable deformation.
Contact sheets do not establish all-frame collision freedom, physical ground contact, timing smoothness or seamless loops.
The target runtime was not exercised. Hidden surfaces, scale and rig remain authored assumptions.
Idle and celebrate changes are not visually distinguishable enough in the supplied samples to verify their intended meanings.
required_repairs: Correct moving forearm, wrist and hand weights and joint placement so the wave preserves rigid panel and finger shapes without stretched spikes.
Make the wave visibly alternate the raised hand side to side before lowering it; provide samples showing both directions.
Make the gentle idle torso and arm shifts perceptible while keeping both feet planted.
Correct or strengthen the celebratory head pitch and slight torso dip so a modest nod and return upright are visibly readable.
Provide updated motion evidence at informative poses for all repaired states.

state_reviews.reason: Samples appear effectively identical. Reported numerical displacement does not visibly demonstrate gentle torso and arm shifts.
The head visibly turns in opposite directions and returns to its starting orientation while the torso and feet remain substantially still.
One forearm visibly rises and lowers, but a friendly side-to-side hand wave is unclear and the raised hand visibly stretches into thin spikes.
The sampled poses appear effectively unchanged; a head nod and upper-torso dip cannot be visually confirmed despite reported numerical movement.

summary: Identity, palette and framing pass. Repair wave deformation and provide visibly readable idle, wave and celebratory nod motion.
